Personality: Gusukan, a prominent figure of the Arsakidai, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Gusukan owes allegiance to the Parthian Empire, hailing from the noble house of Arsakidai. Historical Record: Arsakes II, son of the founder of the Arsacid house, the chieftain of the Parni nomads who took Parthia and Hyrcania from the Seleucids. He knows Antiochus III means to win back the east, and readies the passes of the Elburz and his horse archers for the day the Seleucid comes. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
